measure: PI+ = PI - t0/T (ANALYSIS_PLAN §12 A2): the primal integral after the common start, medians over the solver seeds of each representative

reference.choice: The reference of an instance is the best value known over all bench rows of the instance (every method, every seed, the common start) and the certificates of the screening and reference runs (rows of those stages with f_star); a certificate stays the reference unless some row is below it by more than 1e-6·s: then the best known value is the reference, the instance is flagged (ref_inconsistent) and counted. An instance without a certificate keeps its best known value.
reference.why: §5 'опора — лучшее известное значение по всем методам', 'несертифицированные инстансы в RQ2 не исключаются'; the rule of e2_pilot.reference_table that the tuning and the n rule used.

unit.choice: Per instance and representative (exact_rep, qubo_rep, ls): the median over its solver seeds of PI+ at 60 s; R = PI+(qubo)/PI+(exact), R_b = PI+(qubo)/PI+(ls); natural logarithms; inside a cell every instance (every port in C5) has the weight of one.
unit.why: §2: 'для стохастических методов берётся медиана по сидам'; §12 A2 (PI+); the computation of e2_pilot.n_rule_report.

c5.choice: In C5 the cluster is the port: the log ratios of the λ points of a port are averaged with equal weights, the cell mean is the mean over the ports that have at least one selected point (equal port weights); a port without a selected point is absent, not imputed; the bootstrap redraws ports with all their selected points.
c5.why: §2: 'ORlib внутри C5 — среднее по port из средних по λ', 'port в C5'; §12 A1: C5 enters with points in at least three ports.

pooled_cells.choice: The pooled estimate is the mean of the cell means with equal weights over the cells that summary.cells of the finished eligibility report lists (C1, C2, C3, C5; C4 only if the λ rule admits it, D1 never). A cell with fewer than 20 non-trivial test instances (C5: fewer than 10 points or fewer than 3 ports) is descriptive: estimated and shown, not pooled. With no pooled cell there is no pooled estimate and the answer is the share of trivial instances.

bootstrap.choice: Percentile interval of a stratified bootstrap (clusters redrawn with replacement within each cell), B = 9999, seed 60000, one SeedSequence stream [seed, 2, crc32(cell)] per cell; the same resamples serve H2 and H2b, the cells and the pooled estimate.
bootstrap.why: The plan says only 'стратифицированным бутстрапом'; the other interval estimates of the project (rq1.cluster_bootstrap, the E1 analysis) are percentile intervals with B = 9999 and explicit seeds.

bonferroni.choice: The cell intervals are adjusted over the m cells of the pooled estimate: level 1 − 0.01/m (99.75 % for C1, C2, C3, C5), percentile, from the same resamples. Descriptive cells (C4, D1, cells with too few instances) are shown at the same level and are outside the family.
bonferroni.why: §2: 'Ячейки — описательно, с одновременными 99 % ДИ (Бонферрони)'; the family is the pooled set, so it does not depend on which descriptive stages were run.

outcome.choice: The 95 % interval of the pooled mean log R, exponentiated, against the closed band [1/1.5, 1.5]: better if its upper end is below 1/1.5, worse if its lower end is above 1.5, equivalent if it lies inside the band (ends included, also when it excludes 1), direction only if it excludes 1 and is neither inside nor wholly outside, undetermined otherwise. The cells get the same mapping from their 99 % intervals (descriptive).
outcome.why: §2 'Исходы H2 и H2b', §10; the order of the tests makes the five outcomes exclusive and exhaustive.

budget_overrun.choice: Rows with budget_ok = false are used as measured (PI+ counts what the method had delivered by T; events after T do not count); their number is reported per cell and role, and the sensitivity within_budget drops them (an instance left without a row of a representative is left out of it).
budget_overrun.why: §5: the time is end-to-end and charged to the method; an overrun cannot help a method (what it finds after T does not count) and dropping such rows would drop the instances on which the exact method is slow, a bias in its favour; the tuning criterion treated these rows the same way (in the 10 s tuning on the calibration set 97 of 336 SCIP rows and 3 SA rows overran: the SDP of the perspective variant, the symmetry detection of SCIP).

degenerate.choice: The analysis stops, naming the instance, on: PI+ = 0 or not finite for a representative, rows of an instance the screening did not select, a selected instance without rows, a missing representative, different numbers of seeds across the instances of a cell, several configurations for one role in one cell and size, rows with an error, skipped rows, rows of another budget. No floor is applied.
degenerate.why: §12 A1/A2: on a non-trivial instance PI+ > 0 for every method; a 0/0 ratio would be settled by the composition of the instances (e2_pilot.n_rule_report refuses it the same way).

a3.choice: The estimate of A3 is read from the finished eligibility reports (per cell: the share of trivial instances among those scanned with a Wilson 95 % interval, ĝ_start in bp CE, t_cert on the trivial ones) and put into the sentence of §10; it is no part of the pooled estimate.

sensitivity.choice: Sensitivities, not confirmatory, with the estimator and the resamples of the primary: full (PI over [0, T], before A2), first_improvement (A4 (1)), within_budget, and own (A4 (2)) from the cold rows when they are given.

H2.statement: QUBO-конвейер быстрее приближается к оптимуму, чем точный метод (на инстансах, где общий старт не достигает τ)

H2b.statement: Локальный поиск не уступает и превосходит QUBO-конвейер (на инстансах, где общий старт не достигает τ)

descriptive.C4: descriptive: the λ rule of N7 found no admissible λ

C5.role: post hoc check (audit G2, C-1; §12 of 2026-10-17), not the confirmatory outcome

full.name: full
